note.zh-TW: 範本裡每個要填的地方都用雙大括號包起來，開頭寫「請填：」（英文範本寫「FILL:」）。成品裡留下任何一個，檢查工具都會報錯（STR015）。在網址或指令裡的待填處不要有空白，例如 {{請填：帳號}}、{{FILL:owner}}。
note.en: Every blank in a template is wrapped in double curly braces and starts with "FILL:" ("請填：" in Traditional Chinese templates). Any one left in a finished README is an error (STR015). Inside a link or a command, keep it free of spaces, for example {{FILL:owner}}.

note.zh-TW: 說明只有刪節號的 {{請填：…}}、{{FILL: ...}}，是在介紹這個寫法本身，不是還沒填的地方，檢查工具不報。範本裡真正的待填處一定要寫說明文字。
note.en: A blank whose description is only an ellipsis, such as {{FILL: …}} or {{請填：...}}, is talking about the syntax itself, not a missing value, so the checker does not report it. Real blanks in templates always carry a description.

note.zh-TW: 中文以字計（一個英文單字算一個字），英文以字元計。
note.en: Chinese is counted in characters (an English word counts as one), English in characters.
